title: DoctorPing
$comment: Generated by `pnpm build` in contracts/ from typespec/. Do not edit.

id.description: Unique per source. A consumer that sees the same source and id twice handles the event once.

subject.description: The ID of the thing the event is about: work item, gate, run, score or pull request.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context (CloudEvents distributed tracing extension).

data.description: A ping carries nothing but its ID.

description:
console: `console doctor --deep` checks that an event reaches the foreman (ADR 0120). The ID is fresh and random;
the foreman shows it on `GET /v1/doctor/pings/{id}` and acts on nothing else.
